claim_boundary: Repository-local G2 safety contracts may be developed and tested on native Windows and Ubuntu WSL, but neither environment is a physical Ubuntu A1 certification board. Pure state machines, fake devices, injected executors, and WSL observations are non-closing evidence.

blockers.title: Formal G1 entry dependencies remain deferred
blockers.development_work: G2 development proceeds only under the existing explicit deferral boundary and inherits the tested G1 interfaces without claiming a certified G1 tuple.
blockers.resolution: Close all mandatory G1 entry dependencies or approve them through the governed final-certification process without weakening any G2 exit criterion.

blockers.title: Two native Ubuntu 24.04 A1 boards and disposable disk fixtures are unavailable
blockers.development_work: The current laptop supports non-destructive contract tests only; Windows and its Ubuntu 26.04 WSL guest remain one physical machine.
blockers.resolution: Establish E1 and E2 with native Ubuntu 24.04, stable device inventories, recoverable firmware keys, and separately identified disposable disks, then execute the destructive installation and recovery suite.

blockers.title: Signed offline 4-6B release assets and lab signing/recovery custody are absent
blockers.development_work: A digest-pinned Qwen3-4B Q4_K_M artifact completed bounded native Windows CUDA and Ubuntu WSL CPU/direct-gateway development smoke, and Gemma 4 E2B/E4B candidates are recorded. The Qwen artifact and derived tuple remain unsigned development assets, while the Gemma candidates have not been acquired or executed locally; none is eligible for the G2 base image or T02 acceptance.
blockers.resolution: Produce a verified offline bundle containing a legally approved signed 4-6B pack and exact runtime assets, using protected lab trust roots and independently recoverable credentials.

blockers.title: Physical verified boot, A/B image, encryption, and recovery implementation is absent
blockers.development_work: Pure installer and boot-state contracts are non-destructive development scaffolding and do not write disks, enroll keys, build a UKI, configure dm-verity/LUKS2, or change firmware state.
blockers.resolution: Build and sign the Ubuntu image and recovery media, then retain T01 and T03-T05 plus T45-T49 evidence including interruption, tamper, recovery, and three-attempt fallback results on E1 and E2.

blockers.title: Enforcing cgroup, AppArmor, seccomp, device, peer-credential, and generated-code isolation adapters are absent
blockers.development_work: The typed helper boundary uses injected trust, authorization, journal, device, and executor interfaces; it never performs a privileged host action and cannot prove enforcement.
blockers.resolution: Implement and independently review the Linux privileged service, kernel peer-credential transport, cgroup v2 and device enforcement, signed AppArmor/seccomp policy, and fail-closed KVM microVM or separately qualified constrained runtime on the retained tuples.

blockers.title: Complete G2 functional, security, lifecycle, and performance suite is not executed
blockers.development_work: Deterministic unit and fault-model tests cover only repository-local contracts. They are labeled as non-closing and retain all hardware-dependent cases as blocked.
blockers.resolution: Complete T01-T16, applicable T27-T30, T33, T40, T45-T51, and T62; the governed security/manual matrix; Q01, Q02, Q06-Q09; 1,000 lifecycle cycles; and both-board vertical workflows.
